name: Toaru Biyaku no Denji Mokuroku
original_name: とある媚薬の電磁目録
source:
Ind*x accidentally drink the aphrodisiac left in a bottle she found.
Thus begins the perverted actions---
T*mo K*mijo happens to come by and join in...!

Choosing which is the receiver/inserter will change scenes.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE248786.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
茵蒂克丝意外喝下了瓶中留下的催情剂。
变态行为就此开始——
上条当麻恰好路过，也加入其中……！

选择谁接受、谁插入，会改变场景。
